style_block: PHOTO STYLE: an unedited smartphone snapshot that a friend took in Israel, on the phone's ordinary main wide camera held at chest height. Everything is in focus, with no background blur. Plain natural daylight (late morning or early afternoon) with hard, real shadows and a pale, slightly hazy sky that may be a little overexposed; true-to-life, slightly muted colours; the phone's normal processing with fine sensor noise. No colour grading, no filters, no golden hour, no sunset, no dramatic clouds, no lens flare, no studio light, no cinematic look. The framing is casual and a little imperfect (slightly tilted, someone partly cut by the edge), a quick photo between friends, not a fashion shoot and not an advertisement. PEOPLE: ordinary Israelis of mixed backgrounds (for example Mizrahi, Ashkenazi, Ethiopian-Israeli, Russian-Israeli), in their twenties or thirties unless described otherwise, not models, not celebrities and not athletes. Natural skin with pores, freckles, stubble or a bit of sweat, frizzy or messy hair, normal bodies, relaxed expressions caught mid-moment (talking, laughing, squinting in the sun), mostly looking at each other rather than at the camera. Everyday clothes with the jerseys: jeans or shorts, sneakers or sandals, a cap, sunglasses pushed up, a small backpack or a water bottle. JERSEYS: reproduce every jersey exactly as in its reference photo: the same colours, stripes, collar, crest, manufacturer logo and sponsor text, spelled exactly, with no extra text, no player names and no numbers added. They are worn loosely and look real: slightly wrinkled, hanging naturally. TEXT AND SYMBOLS (strict): there is no writing of any kind anywhere in the image: no graffiti, no signs, no posters, no stickers, no letters, words or numbers on walls, benches, fences, cars or objects. No flags and no political, religious or national symbols. The only lettering in the whole image is what is printed on the jerseys in the reference photos, and no other logos or brand names appear.
